Bihar ki rajdhani patna ko uttar bihar se jorne vali mahatvapurn kachchi dargah-bidupur chhah len ganga pul pariyojna ab udghatan se pahle rajnitik charcha ke kendr men aa gaee hai. karib 4,488 karor rupye ki lagat se taiyar is pul ka 21 navanbar 2026 ko pradhanmantri narendr modi lokarpan karenge. pul ka nam nitish setu rakhe jane ke bad endie aur rashtriy janta dal ke bich shrey lene ki rajniti bhi tej ho gaee hai.
